subject: metrics
text: | Send → readback latency (design readback states `open` → `read back`) | `viola.send.confirm_ms` ← `duration_ms` of the `send-confirmed` lines whose `confirmed` is not `false` (an unconfirmable send's line carries `duration_ms` too, but it had no confirmation window and is no readback). `duration_ms` runs from the send's arrival at the wrapper, so a sample includes the readiness gate's wait, up to architecture's `GATE_MAX_WAIT`, ahead of the window (as read in `src/run/send.rs` at chunk 2026-10-07-send-waits-out-the-paste-hint, not changed there) | histogram | ms | raw samples |

subject: metrics
text: | `unknown` fallback / higher-`v` rejections | `viola.compat.unknown` ← `send-refused{refusal:"unknown"}`; `viola.compat.v_rejected` ← `channel-response{error_code:-32602}` — over-counts: `-32602` also answers `send`'s invalid params (`ProtocolError::InvalidParams`, `"invalid params"`), `release` carrying `from` and a `link` / `unlink` with a missing, non-string or invalid name, a `driven` that is not the serving wrapper or a `driver` equal to `driven`, and the client's `fault_of` labels any `-32602` unsupported-version, until the line tells the causes apart | counter | 1 | n/a |

subject: metrics
text: | Child / probe exits | `viola.child.exit` ← `process-exit{subject, child_exit_status, exit_source}` | counter | 1 | n/a |

subject: metrics
text: - `viola.wait.outcome` counts only the `wait` calls answered by a `channel-response`: a `wait` refused before any frame writes none. The CLI's server-verification refusal (Linux and Windows) is one `process-exit{subject:"self", exit_code:21, detail:"server-verify-failed", during:"connect"}` at WARN in `cli-<name>.ndjson`, counted by the Counter row's `detail` grouping; MCP's `wait` tool writes no line for it.

subject: metrics
text: - A CLI `wait` refused by the instance strict-modes check (`client::refuse_untrusted`: exit 21, the instance pair or the `instance-unreachable` document) writes no line at all, neither a `process-exit` nor a `channel-request`, so neither `viola.wait.outcome` nor the Counter row's `detail` grouping counts it; MCP's `wait` tool refused by its `check_instance` (`instance-unreachable`, `detail: null`) writes none either. The exit code or the `isError` code is its only record.

subject: metrics
text:
Canonical quantile snippet (report-only; the gates use `max`):
```sh
# -R + fromjson? skip a torn line as G2 does (jq -s aborts on one); awk 1 ends each file's last line with a newline
awk 1 diagnostics/hook-*.ndjson | jq -R -n '[inputs|fromjson?|select(.event=="hook-decision" and .hook_event=="session-end")|.duration_ms]|sort
  |{n:length,p50:.[length/2|floor],p95:.[length*0.95|floor],max:.[-1]}'
```
